brief: Verify decision-grade, first-party current evidence as of 2026-08-22 for local-first backend finalists and deliberately small bespoke sync designs for a single-household Gleam browser PWA. Coverage must distinguish documented facts from inference, test licenses, operational continuity, browser/offline persistence, sync/conflict/delete semantics, backup and restore, Cloudflare/object-store or Google Drive feasibility, and iOS PWA constraints; it must support a 4–6 architecture shortlist, exclusions for every named option, risk register, contradictions, and falsifiable proofs of concept rather than a universal recommendation.
